pluginGuide.title: Connect {{name}}
pluginGuide.intro: {{name}} connects through an official plugin you install on your own site — here's how:
pluginGuide.cta: View the plugin and install it

wordpress: On the page that opens, click "Download" (or "Install Now" if you get there from Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin)
Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins
Open the "Kaelah AI" menu in your WordPress admin and click "Connect to Kaelah AI"
drupal: Install the module via Composer (composer require drupal/kaelah_ai_connector) or download the archive from the page that opens
Enable it: drush en kaelah_ai_connector, or via Extend in the Drupal admin
Go to Configuration > Web services > Kaelah AI and click "Connect to Kaelah AI"
prestashop: Download the module (ZIP file) from the page that opens
In your back office, go to Modules > Module Manager > Upload a module, and upload the ZIP
Once installed, open its configuration and click "Connect to Kaelah AI"

seoTrends2026.title: SEO trends to watch in 2026
seoTrends2026.excerpt: AI search, conversational content, E-E-A-T: here's what will redefine search this year.
content: Search is evolving faster than ever. With the rise of conversational engines and AI-generated summaries, traditional SEO isn't enough anymore: you now need to optimize to be cited by an AI, not just ranked in a list of links.

Conversational content is overtaking isolated keywords. Modern search engines understand the intent behind a full question — structure your product pages and articles as clear answers to real customer questions.

E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authority, Trust) is becoming central. Verified reviews, identified authors and structured data strengthen the trust that search engines — and AIs — place in your site.
Finally, speed and mobile accessibility remain non-negotiable. A slow site loses rankings even with great content. Kaelah automatically audits these three pillars to help you prioritize.

aiCommerce.title: How AI is transforming independent e-commerce
aiCommerce.excerpt: From chatbots to personalized recommendations, artificial intelligence is no longer reserved for big retailers.
content: For a long time, artificial intelligence remained the domain of e-commerce giants with dedicated data teams. That's no longer the case: tools like Kaelah make these capabilities accessible to any store, in just a few clicks.
Automatic customer replies, optimized product listing generation, sales trend detection: AI takes care of repetitive tasks so merchants can focus on their offer and customer relationships.
The real transformation isn't just automation, but personalization at scale: every customer can receive a response or recommendation tailored to their history, with no extra manual effort.
Stores that adopt these tools early gain a measurable productivity edge — less time on admin, more time on growth.

shopifyAutomation.title: Automating your Shopify store: the complete guide
shopifyAutomation.excerpt: Save hours every week by automating your product listings, customer support and sales reports.
content: Automating your Shopify store doesn't mean losing control — quite the opposite. Properly configured, automation frees up time for strategic decisions by handling repetitive tasks.
Start with product listings: SEO titles, descriptions and ALT tags can be generated and optimized in bulk, with human review before publishing to keep control over quality.
For customer support, an automated first line of response to frequent questions (shipping, returns, availability) frees up valuable time while keeping human escalation for complex cases.
Finally, automatically generated weekly sales reports let you spot trends without opening a dashboard every day. Just connect your store to Kaelah to get started.
